parties: Axita Cotton Limited (prospective resolution applicant); Varidhi Cotspin Private Limited (debtor company in CIRP)
headline: Axita Cotton files Expression of Interest in Varidhi Cotspin CIRP
sum: Axita Cotton Limited has filed an expression of interest to participate in the corporate insolvency resolution process of Varidhi Cotspin Private Limited, signalling intent to acquire or restructure the cotton-spinning entity under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code.
implication: Early-stage IBC play: a filing of EOI by a competitor/industry player in textile/cotton signals either consolidation intent or distressed M&A opportunity; EOI stage precedes formal resolution plan submission and NCLT approval.
detail: Axita Cotton Limited, listed on NSE, has disclosed to the exchange its filing of an expression of interest (EOI) for participation in the corporate insolvency resolution process (CIRP) of Varidhi Cotspin Private Limited. Varidhi Cotspin is a cotton-spinning entity that has entered formal insolvency proceedings under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016. The EOI is the initial step in the statutory resolution process, preceding formal resolution plan submission. No acquisition value, timeline or plan structure has been disclosed at this stage.

framework.ref: Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016, Chapter II (Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process)
framework.note: central-governs CIRP initiation, stakeholder eligibility, EOI submission, resolution plan requirements and NCLT approval; defines who can be a resolution applicant.
central-specifies disqualifications for resolution applicants (connected persons, wilful defaulters); Axita must meet eligibility.

framework.ref: IBBI (Insolvency Resolution Process for Corporate Persons) Regulations, 2016, Regulation 5
framework.note: central-governs EOI format, submission deadline, information disclosure and preparation of preliminary EOI list by insolvency professional.

framework.ref: IBBI (Insolvency Resolution Process for Corporate Persons) Regulations, 2016, Regulation 12-19
framework.note: amended-covers resolution plan requirements, evaluation criteria, NCLT approval jurisdiction and modification of resolution plans post-approval.
central-threshold for NCLT approval is 66% of committee of creditors votes; plan must comply with statutory objectives.

framework.ref: Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, Regulation 30
framework.note: amended-requires listed entity (Axita) to disclose material events (including participation in insolvency/M&A) to exchange within stipulated time.

framework.ref: IBC 2016, Section 5(22) & 5(24) (Definition of Debtor and Creditor)
framework.note: framework-establishes statutory creditor and debtor standing; creditor committee will adjudicate claims against Varidhi Cotspin.

conditions: Axita must be eligible under IBC 2016 Section 29A (not a disqualified person)
EOI submission within timeline set by insolvency professional
Formal resolution plan to be submitted if shortlisted by IP
66% approval by committee of creditors (CoC) of Varidhi Cotspin
NCLT approval required under IBC Section 31
approvals: Committee of Creditors (CoC) approval of resolution plan (≥66%)
structure.novel: Filing of EOI by a listed competitor in the textile/cotton-spinning sector; potential consolidation play in structured insolvency.

triggers.note: CIRP triggered; IBC Section 29A eligibility and IBBI Regulation 5 EOI procedures govern Axita's participation.

triggers.law: SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015
triggers.note: Axita (as listed entity) must disclose material corporate action (EOI/CIRP participation) to NSE within stipulated timeline.

triggers.law: IBBI (Insolvency Resolution Process for Corporate Persons) Regulations, 2016
triggers.note: Governs timeline, format and evaluation of EOI; defines preliminary list and resolution plan requirements.
